title: Centered Kickoff application launcher popup
line: Kickoff can now open its popup in the center of the panel, like the Windows 11 Start menu.
explanation: Kickoff's popup is always placed next to its launcher button, so on a full-width or centered dock-like panel it opens at the edge rather than in the middle, and there was no way to change that. A new "Popup position" option in Kickoff's General settings (Next to the launcher / Centered on the panel, default unchanged) makes the popup use the whole panel as its anchor, so it opens centered on the panel; it only shows and applies when Kickoff is in a panel.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: add an option to open the popup centered on the panel

On centered or dock-like panels the popup always opened next to the
launcher button, which looks out of place. A new "Popup position" option
in the General page can now open it in the center of the panel instead.

BUG: 518337

media.caption: Default full-width panel: Kickoff opens at the left edge, next to its button
With "Centered on the panel": Kickoff opens in the middle of the panel
Settings before: no popup position option
New "Popup position" option in Kickoff's General settings
Left vertical panel: the popup is centered vertically along the panel

review.text: The opt-in option is what the wish asks for, it keeps the default unchanged, and the media show the popup centered on horizontal and vertical panels. However, the implementation reaches from Kickoff's main.qml into the shell-owned popup window (fullRepresentationItem.Window.window) and overrides the visualParent that desktoppackage's CompactApplet.qml binds to root.compactRepresentation. That depends on CompactApplet internals and on which window the full representation happens to live in, and it fights the shell's own binding. Maintainers would want this anchoring exposed as a supported hook rather than an applet patching its host's window.
changes: Add a proper hook for the popup anchor: for example a PlasmoidItem property in libplasma (such as a 'popup anchored to the panel' / popupAnchor setting) that desktoppackage/contents/applet/CompactApplet.qml reads when choosing the dialog's visualParent, and have Kickoff set it from its centerPopup option instead of binding the popup window's visualParent directly
Verify opening by clicking the launcher button, not only through the shortcut
